verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is an SDK migration guide for Stripe Terminal SDK version 5.0.0. It shows the SDK uses major versions with documented migration paths, but nothing documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec repository shows a published API spec, not a versioning or deprecation commitment. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme, documented deprecation policy or timelines, support windows for old versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Learn how to migrate to version 5.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.
